neighbours.label: A noun picked out one at a time by 'individual' or 'single' (individual parts, single gene, single works), vs the same nouns after plural quantifiers
fire: The software lets you edit individual frames of the animation.
Teachers should give feedback on individual essays, not just the class average.
A single mutation can be enough to cause the disease.
The museum sells single day passes at the front desk.
Researchers tracked individual birds with small radio tags.
The judge looked at each individual case on its merits.
You can download single tracks instead of the whole album.
The app shows the price of individual items in your basket.
quiet: The software lets you edit many frames of the animation at once.
Teachers should give feedback on all the essays, not just the class average.
Several mutations can be enough to cause the disease.
The museum sells weekly passes at the front desk.
Researchers tracked large flocks of birds with radar.
The judge looked at all the cases together on Monday.
You can download the whole album instead of buying the CD.
The app shows the total price of the items in your basket.
